ctaHeading: Need a Mechanic in Hoppers Crossing?
aboutText: At Hoppers Service Centre, we've been serving Hoppers Crossing with top-quality automotive care for years. Our skilled mechanics handle everything from minor services to major repairs, ensuring your vehicle runs smoothly. We specialise in Kumho tyres, wheel alignments, and provide log book servicing for all makes and models. With a focus on customer satisfaction, we offer free loan cars and payment plans for your convenience.
servicesText: We provide a full range of mechanical services, from routine maintenance to complex repairs. Our team ensures your vehicle is safe and reliable on the road.
